A substitute currency issued in Zelgrad after the implementation of Anatoliy Svetlanov Buterin's ordinances at the beginning of 1102. Normally only distributed within the residential park, where it is traded for daily necessities, food, medicine, etc.
From events
'Factory scrip'

Nobody knows why the coins stamped with the Tsar's face suddenly stopped being of any use here, forcing people to start trading using these thin circles of metal. At first, their rough edges cut their hands, even peeling away the thick calluses on their knuckles. Eventually, they noticed it was not only their calluses being sliced away. It was also their dignity.
Special Looseleaf Stickers for Fashion Collections usable as decorations.
Complete Relaunch Anchor Themed Set to obtain
Sticker Pack/Relaunch Anchor
Get ready to follow a new course.
Scraps of unsent letters. Those who find these can choose to either preserve them as evidence, or toss them to the still-burning bonfire in exchange for a pittance of warmth.
Broken Verses

'To all who have held onto their tomorrows, I bestow what life and hope remain in me to every soul who seeks freedom and happiness. I will be dead before morning light... Mama, I call out your name, and you are Ursus, yet who am I?'
A batch headhunting permit issued by the Rhodes Island HR Department; Can be used at a certain time to recruit talented Operators, 10 rolls at once.
Rage of the Many Ten-roll Headhunting Permit

In order to ensure the available talent pool can be scaled upwards to satisfy the Doctor's emergency preparation request, this batch of headhunting items carries specificity, time-sensitivity, and of course, a degree of risk.
A special permit from Rhodes Island HR for recruiting special talents at special points in time. Can be used to recruit one operator.
Rage of the Many Headhunting Permit
A voucher that can be exchanged for rewards at 'Rhodes Island Procurement Center'.
Obtained from Reclamation Algorithm
Mission Acceptance Slip
Completing missions to build the new base will earn you these acceptance slips. Closure's favorite right now.
Obtained from Stronghold Protocol: Alliance
Emote Set: Stronghold Protocol

The cork stoppers Golden Prairie uses for red wine intended for the Nuova Volsiniese market, with a special seal stuck on top. Collect enough and exchange them at the Red Wine Championship Commission reception counter for prizes (such as tickets to watch the championship).
Limited Event Drop
Cork Stopper

The big prizes demand far too many corks in exchange. The vast majority will trade in for a few mismatched tasting wineglasses at best. It is a blatantly Kazimierzian marketing ploy, but that has not deterred Golden Prairie from relying on it to open up the Nuova Volsiniese market.
Can be exchanged for all sorts of supplies in Stronghold Protocol.
Event Stage drop, Event mission reward
Stronghold Credits
Medals prepared by Rhodes Island's workshop for operators participating in Stronghold Protocol. Magnetic. Apparently, if you gather enough of them, you can make a fortress out of chess pieces.

A history manuscript yet to be approved. Hand it to a certain Magistrate of Water, and she will gladly offer you excess supplies from the Sky Mirror Pavilion. Once compiled, It will transcend its era, endure the test of time, and be judged before becoming time itself.
Draft of History
A chronicle of an event's beginning and end, an examination of an era's gains and losses, an analysis of one's rights and wrongs, to be settled with a single verdict.
Complete Tales Within the Sand Themed Set to obtain
Sticker Pack/Tales Within the Sand
Admire the artistic mesh of desert and oasis.
Complete Garden of Grotesqueries Themed Set to obtain
Sticker Pack/Garden of Grotesqueries
Tourists entranced by enchanting landscapes.
Complete Furnaceside Fables Themed Set to obtain
Sticker Pack/Furnaceside Fables
The land witnesses the Sarkaz's splendid forms.
Complete Silverfrost Frontier Themed Set to obtain
Sticker Pack/Silverfrost Frontier
Seek the beauty of mystery in the bitter cold.
Complete Caerula Arbor Themed Set to obtain
Sticker Pack/Caerula Arbor
The tides call out for you to travel.
Complete Crimson Solitaire Themed Set to obtain
Sticker Pack/Crimson Solitaire
A grand encompassing performance.
A themed Fashion Collections set containing a Custom Looseleaf and stickers, easily placed and displayed.
Fashion Collections Gift
A new melody composed for today's display.
Looseleaf/Rhodes Fashion Review
Create your own unique style.

A damaged Originium lamp found in the Dark Woods. Once Na Saoirsí's supply issues were resolved, the citizens spontaneously decided to organize, taking out the only supplies they had on hand to recover these relics of the war.
Broken Originium Lamp

One tradition Tarans brought back is wearing an Originium lamp at their hips. Once, people would take them into the Dark Woods, but now those bodies have been scattered by the wind. Not even shadows are left, only shattered lamps.

An essential item for Athenian citizens when voting. But what to do with used ostraca? Astynomos' Office decided to collect and wrap them up nicely for tourist souvenirs, and this innovative idea was well received by all.
Even though everyone has a terminal loaded with all kinds of apps these days, the Minoans still prefer to follow their ancient traditions.
Can be exchanged for the corresponding event stage reward.
Limited-time event missions
'Strategist' Point
Rhodes Island issues special reward points as an incentive to field operators contributing to Integrated Strategies operations. These points can be used to redeem important supplies.
Don't be stingy when it comes to complimenting how the food smells at Savors at Yu's. Once the Young Chef's ears go red from praise, he'll discreetly add a few extra bits of meat to your plate.
'Yum-yum!'

Fragrant meals fear not alleys deep. While invisible to the eye on most days, there is a faint aroma lining the streets, at least until it hits you face-first in front of the restaurant it leads to. You need only follow the scent of food to paint a grand picture of Baizao's streets.
Both the daily drink of the pirates of the Salt Flat, and a currency they accept. So long as the fleet lacks priceless treasures such as rum, it will never be replaced.
Saltfin Garum

Beverage made from chopped saltfin viscera and fermented with microorganisms from the underground rivers beneath the Salt Flat. The stench is both invigorating and tear-inducing. And as for its other properties... 'Has anyone told that idiota in the kitchen that you don't need to add any goddamn salt to a saltfin?!'
An innovative beverage inspired by high-altitude air-supply devices, now the lifeblood of Columbians. No one would refuse to fork over a high price to taste a new era beyond the Starpod.
Dr Oxygen

It's just cheap sugar water based on Forte Energy Drinks' flavoring? Who cares! Nowadays, you only hear such boring truths from bitter and bankrupt companies that didn't think of bottling their beverages in rocket-shaped containers.
Event Mission Reward
Particle Tracking
Rapid Charge
Precision Focus
Guardian Core
Used to perform Data Iteration on Limiter Units.
Event Stages
Data Blackbox
An encrypted data block. Always remember, the conversion of information often entails unavoidable wear. Make good use of your information storage devices, but do not depend on them.
Experience gained from finished trials. Upgrades trial levels.
Trial EXP
Right and wrong are far from crucial in a simulation. They are only a form of support. They help you make the correct choices when the battle is real.

Multi-functional survey equipment scattered throughout the snow from the avalanches. Please return it to the observation station when found, and the staff will express their gratitude with practical supplies.
Multi-functional Snow Detector

A survey instrument developed by Rhine Lab specifically for use in Kjerag to collect various data from the mysterious snowy realm, maintaining stable functionality even in low-temperature environments. 'Myths are merely unexplained realities, and science will one day snatch off their veils.'—Elena firmly believes in this.

Invitations handed out by an anonymous figure at Carnevale. You can exchange them for generous gifts at any Fiera delle Meraviglie Notturne. Relax, once people see the invitation, you will receive a warm welcome.
Invito Mistico

The anonymous sender calls themselves 'Il Signore del Carnevale'. It is unclear if this title is a threat or in jest. The dark red soaking the paper isn't blood, but rather a fragrant wine, which seems to say that this invitation was born alongside Carnevale itself.
Exclusive Ten-roll Headhunting Permit
The Silent Wavelengths Headhunting Permit
Contains an Emergency Sanity Sampler and some Rhodes Island Supplies.
Rhodes Island Supply Crate
A materials supply crate issued alongside Sanity samplers, giving you a random material as you restore your Sanity.
A hollow crystal shell, once crammed full of an unbroken stream of information. Now it sleeps alongside silent light and shadow.
Drops from Main Theme stages
She still remembers that murmur spanning both time and the boundary between life and death: Search for traces of life. Search for hope and a future. Find yourself.
An unexploded dud. It must be handed over to relevant authorities once disarmed and disassembled.
Obtain from Main Theme
Unexploded Dud
The corruption of the empire may not have begun with Grypherburg, but its decline surely started with a dud from Tulskaya.
The flag of Ursus with the mark of Reunion painted over it. Defacing the national flag is punishable by death according to the Flag Law of Ursus.
Altered Flag
The nobles of Grypherburg see this symbol as a grave threat, but it was from their hubris that it came about in the first place.
An abandoned mining lamp that still works, though the name tag has been torn off.
Ownerless Mining Lamp
People speculate as to who its master was. It has been passed from one person to another, carrying more and more stories, the culmination of the miners' lives.
A piece of deactivated Originium that no longer has any practical value, even if it is polished into the shape of an Originite Prime.
Dull Originium
Once, they said it was the origin of suffering. Now, they say its disappearance was the beginning of tragedy.
An indispensable tool in the wilderness of Ursus, lighting the flame that drives back the cold and darkness. Fire is banned in the mines, but that has not stopped the miners from sharing flints.

The sound of hitting flint fades into the vast snow. The darkness is boundless, with only a tiny speck of flame to illuminate it, quietly flickering and melting the ice and snow, and waiting for the sun to rise again.
Icebreak Points
The Icebreaker Games have the spotlight today thanks to your wholehearted support.
As you collect Participation Certificates, so does Hype. Reach certain Hype levels to receive rewards.
Obtained from Icebreaker Games #2
Participation Certification - S2
A certificate of participation in Rhodes Island's Icebreaker Games. 'Leave your sweat in the stadium. Come home with camaraderie.'
HR resource pack for recruitment, allowing a large number of Operators to be recruited via public channels.
Thank-You Celebration Recruiting Supplies
Events equal marketing, so it is only natural that HR would be busy during this time. You owe ■■■ one.
Special Redemption Point
Rhodes Island issues special redemption points as an incentive to field operators. These points can be used to redeem important supplies.

A piece of a dream-shaped puzzle, dazzling and beautiful. You found these strewn across the floor when you came to the Castle. Now, be patient, gather them together, and see the wondrous scenes you bring to life once more.
Dream Puzzle Pieces

No matter its beauty, a dream is but a dream, destined to fade from memory in time. It is hence that the masters of the Castle of Dreams have made a museum to hold onto these vanishing dreams, storing them in the manner of precious works of art. Each master has their own tastes, so take care not to offend with what you give them.

Strategic Beacon

Virtual marker with Closure's crypto-signature. The quantity deployed is carefully calculated, ensuring that aid provided by Rhodes Island HQ is utilized efficiently.
'More interesting than a plain paper production plan, don't you think?'
Can be used to increase Operator skill level in Rebuilding Mandate.
Skill Handbook
Building and producing is no less a chore than fighting and killing. Remain vigilant and work together.
Can be used to increase Operator training level in Rebuilding Mandate.
Training Handbook
The most important things in the Frontier Outposts are courage, perseverance, and humility. Live, learn, produce.
Credits derived from total resources, which can be used to obtain rewards from Closure.
Resource Point

Rhodes Island was not built in a day, but we build it up day by day.
'For Rhodes Island.'
Obtain the furniture belonging to the two sets 'Tower of Breezes' and 'Chamber of Departing Fowlbeasts' in the 'Fantasies of the Garden' furniture pack.
Obtained from Integrated Strategies
Fantasies of the Garden Furniture Pack II

A room whose decor was inspired by the experiences of Leizi and the others in the Garden of Grotesqueries. Every tree, rock, lantern, and curtain within the Garden has been collected, curated, and brought back by Yi from his travels across the entire country. The world is full of treasures, but lacks people of discernment.
Obtain the furniture belonging to the two sets 'Pavilion of the Rising Sun' and 'Balcony of Warm Scents' in the 'Fantasies of the Garden' furniture pack.
Fantasies of the Garden Furniture Pack I
Fine grains of gems that glitter like stars in the sky, older than the City of Radiance, and brighter than its hidden treasures.
Flowing Glimmerdust

A tourist souvenir from the City of Radiance. It is said that artificers can turn them into large gemstones. 'A padishah once ordered all the gems accumulated in his palace over a thousand years to be ground into fine grains of sand and scattered at the bottom of the garden pond, just so that the citizens could share in the radiance.' - Exhibit label on a mummy in the museum
A carefully-prepared tasting set. Can be exchanged for LMD.
Carefully-Prepared Tasting Set

This is not the type of gift you can simply buy from a luxury store. This is a selection of drinks chosen based on her own tastes and what she thinks you will like, hand-poured bottle by bottle before being carefully sealed. In consideration for the nature of your work, there is also a bottle of sarsaparilla, 100% alcohol-free.
From Soudanshitsu Mikage
'Treasure Pouch'
Used at the Soudanshitsu to start business for the day. The juicy stories you hear every day all start with a chat, after all.
Idle Gossip

Fragmentary words from the streets. They may seem useless, but they hide threads leading to all sorts of secrets. To those who know how to make use of them, even the smallest whisper of gossip can be a stepping stone to business.

A ticket distributed by a talent agency, which can be exchanged for entry into a lottery. After a certain incident, they were the hottest item at the Vintage Bazaar for a while, and could be traded for nearly anything.
Performer Meeting Chuusen-ken

A lottery ticket, the prize being admission to a certain performer's 'graduation' farewell concert. While the event was officially canceled, it is still in private circulation among fans, a memento of a turning point in her career.
Lost Knowledge
Stray Geistlings
A device that stores battle videos of Special Operators. Gives Special Operators a certain amount of EXP.
From events and Special Missions
Special Operator Battle Record

Special Operators do battle in extremely complex environments with highly dynamic conditions, and recording them is equally difficult. But if it ends up helping out in some future battle, it will all be worth it.
This collection comes with a special 'Interesting Highlights' page.

If you bring lost geists that have not yet transformed to Mr. Pu's place, he will give you a few interesting trinkets in return as thanks. You notice the things he previously collected all have their own names.

A small object on the cusp of becoming a geist, taking advantage of humanity's inattention to trundle about. Pranks on the street corner, odd sounds from the depths of stoves... A strange air permeates the town.
Limited-time Event Missions, Daily Event Missions
Full Overload
Redundant Array
Chain Activation
Unlimited Pressure
Strategy Point

Despite the hellish workload and a high-pressure film set, the mysterious black shadow never fails to show up every now and again, to the point that the overwhelmed crew have started to wildly speculate who is behind it. If you can trace the whereabouts of the 'Phantom of the Studio', they will be very grateful.
Phantom of the Studio
What is it, really? A ghost? A prop? A hallucination? Somebody's Friedkin pet? Nobody knows. Miss.Christine simply waves her twin tails as she languidly basks in the sunlight.
Can be exchanged at Breakthrough Milestones for rewards.
'Caution! Wet Floor!'

An ordinary floor sign. After being used to denote acceleration points in stool racing competitions, operators interested in these competitions have become rather fond of it, eventually turning it into a collectible.

The enlightenment of the Shrine of Nurtury has spread like wildfire, and both the living and the unliving have sprouted halos. The first pacifiers to receive them wandered off through the Shrine in their confusion, leaving countless babes to suffer restless nights. If you are able to return them to their posts, the beleaguered nurturers will be happy to give gifts as thanks.
Enlightened Pacifier
A pacifier soaked in saliva, with a miniature halo atop it. The child who threw it away is now wailing incessantly. Guide the way for the lost pacifier, and it will return to the child's side.
One of the more expensive Duel Channel gifts, and can be exchanged on the website for material rewards, with free shipping and home delivery.
Obtained from Duel Channel
Grand Duel Fireworks

Apparently, using it can send a fullscreen fireworks effect along with a message to the entire Duel Channel. But what the richie-riches who break the TOS to spam them in public chat all day might not know is that they can be blocked with a click of a button on the website.
Command: Reconstruction Ten-roll Headhunting Permit
Command: Reconstruction Headhunting Permit
Emote Set
Communicators made by Raidian in the shape of pin badges. Retrieving them can help reduce interference on the comms network, and they can be traded at Closure's for all sorts of supplies.
'Courage' Badge

To help calm the children anxious about leaving the landship, Raidian made these pin badges with paging and messaging functionalities, encouraging them to keep on smiling and stay in contact. After hearing about them, many operators asked her for some, recording words of encouragement on them before hiding them all over prior to the evacuation.
Looks to be made from expensive metals, and can be exchanged for LMD.
Super! Best! Boss Medal
Exusiai suddenly remembered her promise to exchange those medals today. After checking the number of 'Best Boss' medals you have, she skirted around the old rules and gave you this one.
Obtained from Icebreaker Games #1
Participation Certificate - S1
An emote set based on Originium slugs, used to communicate between partners.
Emote Set: Slug Style

'Stop pulling up the corners of your mouth into that stiff smile and try being more like an Originium slug. Open up your shell, spread out your soft parts, and... Believe me, do that, and you'll get over the awkwardness real quick.'
Obtained from Icebreaker Games

A crystal of blood left behind in the battlefield ruins. It is said that if you place it in a deserted nook where roses bloom, when the twin moons are at their brightest, the fortunate will find some unexpected presents waiting for them come daybreak.
Broken Petals

A shattered yet still brilliant crystal shaped like a petal, often seen among death-blackened scorched earth. They are ripples left behind by traveling Canoes, engraved with the final memories and emotions of those who passed away.

An agricultural drone developed by the Tianshi Bureaus, which people occasionally leave lying in the fields after they malfunction. If you pick any up, you can exchange them for goods at Shennong Market.

The newest fruit borne of the Dahuang Tianshi Bureau's research. Simple to control, resiliently mobile. Sample-taking and soil monitoring are among its many functions. Naughty children occasionally make off with them to use in 'fowl fights.'

Burdenbeast Blind Boxes—such a smash hit, Onboard Services ran out of stock for a time. That means this batch couldn't have come sooner, and the train attendants will be delighted to trade other goods for it.
Burdenbeast Blind Box

Blind boxes from the cultural industries in collaboration with 'BangBang Burdenbeast.' Collect all nine, including a limited-edition secret burdenbeast.
NOTE: Pray faithfully to the newly erected Kjeragandr statue, and your odds of drawing the secret one go up!
A reward for first clearing stages which can be used to buy prizes at the Exchange Counter; subsequent reclears will not reward more.
Point Card
The cards might be small, but get enough of them and you can trade them in for big prizes!
A piece of fallen memory, preserved with Arts. It pulses in your palm to the rhythm of emotion. It will be forged into a key before oblivion.
Note of Fear
Knock on the shut door and reach out. We should have been united through fear.
Note of Sorrow
Knock on the shut door and reach out. We should have been united through sorrow.
Note of Anger
Knock on the shut door and reach out. We should have been united through anger.
Note of Joy
Knock on the shut door and reach out. We should have been united through joy.
Leaves that fall on the streets of Zwillingstürme. Missing phrases of music can be found on them from time to time. Give them to tune seekers at concerts and be rewarded with the gift of music.
Die Klänge von den Erinnerungen
Memories of the past are scattered across the ancient capital of Leithanien, carried by broken passages of music. Like today's Leithanien, they will need be tuned before they can be heard.

Every respectable citizen has the right to oppose Parliament's public proposals, and these emblems are Parliament's acknowledgment of said right. But rumor has it that some civil servants at the Office of Proposed Resolutions will secretly trade goods for this valuable right?

An emblem personally gifted by the Madam Speaker for outstanding behavior during battle or reconstruction. Anyone can use them as valuable tokens of opposition during the notice periods of the proposals deciding Londinium's future.
Note that Parliament strictly forbids the trading of this honor!
Never Gilded Headhunting Permit
Obtain all furniture exclusive to the Il Siracusano event not yet acquired.
Record Restoration
Il Siracusano Furniture Pack
The Procurement Department's reconnected with its suppliers, and replenished stocks of initially limited pieces of furniture! Give your thanks to Closure!
Attainment Point
Special memorabilia of Rhodes Island Engineering Department make. Apparently, the Engineering op who designed it took inspiration from a board game that's been all the rage at Rhodes Island.

A daily recipe waiting to be sent to Senshi's Dungeon Diner. If it's nutritionally balanced, you'll get a prize. If you're not sure which ingredients go with which, you can ask Matterhorn, Gummy, or Hibiscus.
Daily Recipe
A reminder for certain operators, especially Kay: The meals recommended in the cookbook are FULL meals! Stop asking if they're just snacks already!
'Expeditioners' Redemption Point
Rhodes Island issues special reward points as an incentive to field operators dispatched to the base building operation in Szubat-Arsalan. These points can be used to redeem important supplies.
Obtain the furniture belonging to the two sets 'Reborn in a Dream' and 'Chronological Eddies' in the 'Memories of the Souls' furniture pack.
Memories of the Souls Furniture Pack II

A room based on what the storytellers saw as they traversed the strange tales. The Logistics Department designer brought their entire imagination to bear, but the storytellers still think the furnishings lack the odd magnificence of the real deal.
Obtain the furniture belonging to the two sets 'Melancholy of Dust' and 'Unending Omens' in the 'Memories of the Souls' furniture pack.
Memories of the Souls Furniture Pack I

Looks good for padding outdoors thermal equipment, but seems to have little use in the current season. The young girl at 'White Volcano' has an inexplicable love for bizarre wool like this, and will surreptitiously trade you goods from the shop for it. N.B.: DO NOT let her big brother know!
Fluffy Critter Wool
Soft, insulating, and highly absorptive, it might look extremely delicious, but please don't start eating it like cotton candy.
Fireworks pieces that fell from the sky. The custodian of a certain furnace node is looking for it, but what you get in return for it seems to differ from person to person.

A large piece of slag that was ejected from the Soul Furnace for unknown reasons, which shattered into pieces when bombarded by the airship. It contains trace amounts of Originium and Oriron, but extraction is extremely difficult.
Stray Myths
Soul Bookmark
Microchip that holds a large number of blueprints, which can be printed at the Materianomicon Moderatrix.
'Emergency Supplies' Blueprint Chip

'Emergency Supplies' Blueprint Chip that contains nearly a thousand ready-to-print blueprints, including survival necessities and equipment for experiments and creative activities. Do not neglect exploration and expression, no matter how dire the circumstances, for the stagnation of the mind and numbing of the spirit is akin to death.
Leave your sweat in the stadium. Come home with camaraderie.
As you collect Mementos, so does Hype. Reach certain Hype levels to receive rewards.

A new formulation from Rhodes Island's Medical R&D, capable of temporarily suppressing the exacerbation of Oripathy in Catastrophe- or battlefield-level Originium zones. THIS DRUG PLACES IMMENSE STRAIN ON THE BODY. USE WITH CAUTION.
Emergency Inhibitor

WARNING: For best results, administer via peripheral IV. In case of first-aid, can attempt via CVC. If shock ensues after first dose, second IV may be administered within 5-7 minutes (repeat dose). EACH DOSE COULD BE THE KEY TO SAVING A LIFE IN THE FIELD. MAKE GOOD USE OF THEM.
Like Ending Like Death Ten-roll Headhunting Permit
Like Ending Like Death Headhunting Permit
A 'hard currency' aboard Babel. Save up enough to spare, and the nice Vampire lady down by the Engineering Team will trade for some scarcities you'll appreciate.
Raw Sugar Lumps
Crude sugar cubes of mechanized make, a Babel wartime supply ration. Provides soldiers with ample energy and a hint of sweetness.

A card for the Galería stamp rally. The more stamps, the more prizes you get. Despite each and every card bearing the limited-daily ultra-rare secret stamps, Reynell will still gladly exchange them for goods. In his words, 'my small token of respect to our anonymous seal-forger supreme.'
Galería Stamp Card
Upon seeing these cards, Tecno indifferently thumbs at a row of halved radishes in the corner of her workshop, each cross-section dyed through in seal ink and ready to go.
Obtain all furniture exclusive to the Guide Ahead event not yet acquired.
Guide Ahead Furniture Collection Set
Progressive Overclock
Strength In Numbers
Preheated Core
Lightened Load
Obtain the furniture belonging to the 'Eqlumuy Oasis' and 'Traditions' sets in the 'Arsalan Travel Tent' furniture series.
Arsalan Furniture Collection II
When the region's so close to the foehn hotlands, furnishings like these in Arsalan add a precious hint of comfort to your room.
Obtain the furniture belonging to the 'Arakeeshtu Jungle' and 'Narutabatim Alkalies' sets in the 'Arsalan Travel Tent' furniture series.
Arsalan Furniture Collection I
A voucher that can be exchanged for rewards at 'Expansional Rewards'.
Prosperity Point
Each bead of sweat shed upon the barren ground will one day bear witness to the prospering of Terran civilization.

Extremely spicy and fantastically invigorating, with a deep velvet flavor fresh bottletree sap can't hope to match. And the upside of not chronically ruining your body like hard liquor would. Give it to wild sandbeasts, and you might end up trading for their stashed curios.
Spicy Bottletree Sap

Bottletree sap naturally fermented in the abdomens of tree-hanging Originium slugs, celebrated by man and adored by sandbeasts. Still, how the beasts get the sap when they can't climb trees is one of Rim Billiton's great mysteries. Are there feral barreners helping them? Can't be...
A folder storing personal notes. Lessing is obtained the first time this item is obtained, and can improve Lessing's Potential thereafter.
Lessing's Folder
Several proverbs are written on the paper with tidy, print-like handwriting. The pen has penetrated the paper in a few places. There are also a few scribbles about things that need to be done.
Stores operation data from the Formulative Battlerealm. Accumulate to advance Cogitative Diving Evaluation progress.
Experimental Dataset
'WARNING! Please refrain from undue perception of/empathy with simulation products, or subsequent generation of false data may lead to irreversible mental damage.'
Can be exchanged for Milestone Rewards.
From event-exclusive drops and event missions
Milestone Fragment
A flickering, glinting fragment. A light so that you no longer fear the dark as you walk dauntlessly on through the thorns.

Combustibles salvaged from Davistown and its environs. Practically worthless for heat, and produces way too much smoke, but fuel is fuel and there's an old worker by the energy tower who'll trade goods from the mine for it.
Shoddy Fuel
Plastics, paper, wood... even scrapped Originium circuitry. Their only commonality is that they all burn when thrown in the power plant, and provide the plate with just that much more heat.
Obtain the furniture belonging to the two sets 'Life in the Forest' and 'Fireside Twitters' in the 'Sami Impressions' furniture series.
Sami Impressions Furniture Pack II
A Sami forest cabin recreated based on Magallan's notes and the supplementary reports from other operators who participated in the expedition. Quiet and simple, as things have always been.

A bunch of papers recording the streamer's various experiences in cute handwriting, but when flipped over becomes a map of a nomadic city, with detailed markings noting the frequency of debt collectors showing up.

A Yumen specialty product, high-purity spirit. Beloved by all drinkers, brewed by all brewers. The file manager in the darkness has another duty: to cleverly let 'secrets' be found by those in the know. The Adeptus Sprawiedliwi have never given up their control of Kazimierz—whether good or ill.
A scale miniature of the Land of the Knights, often elaborately laid out in the decorative cases of parlors.
G.K.T. Commemorative Model

The people use these shining fluorescent lamps to subdue nightfall, such is the light of Kazimierz. In civilized lands, traveling bards sing of gold, wandering knights forced to battle sword with glass. Indifferent are the silent waves; on this small, final vessel, she dredged up glory.

A Kazimierz Major lottery ticket bearing the logo of Pinus Sylvestris. This ticket can be exchanged at the Kazimierz Major Prize Exchange Center for corresponding prizes. Put down your chips, and win your fortune!
Liść Ticket

A lottery ticket issued by a company run by a major knight noble family. Some make a fortune overnight while others go bankrupt. Within this little ticket are condensed the joys, sorrows, blood, and tears of those who resign their fate to a throw of the dice.
A commemoration of Ch'en's special investigation in Dossoles.
Event Milestone Reward
[Holiday's End]

Though when she set off to return to Rhodes Island, Ch'en didn't fully understand the city of Dossoles, neither does she believe there'll come a day she truly does. That said, she'll always remember this place.
['Golden Partner']

In Swire's belief, she needs a partner just as Hoshiguma is to Ch'en, and simultaneously, she believes Lin Yühsia could become that partner. She's made no small effort to see that happen, and ultimately, you can tell how it turned out just by the look on their faces.
[Dragon and Rat in Conflict]
That day, that moment Ch'en and Lin Yühsia came out of the A.H.C. Bar, the gunpowder tension between them had everyone following the championship excited beyond belief.
[Oni and Tiger Twinned Stars]

At the time, Hoshiguma and Swire weren't aware of how they'd handily sorted out Ch'en's objective. The only reason they never ran into her was because Swire immediately dragged Hoshiguma off to go shopping.
Medals specially ordered by Ms. Candela to be cast to commend Ch'en's actions. Accumulate certain amounts and the Dossoles Police Station will issue rewards.
Miss Ch'en Commemorative Medal

Every medal represents Ch'en's swift mid-investigation resolution of incidents unrelated to her assignment from Ms. Candela. During the time she was retained in Dossoles, the city's crime rate reached a record low. As a warning for the local police department, these Ch'en medals have been displayed in the middle of the head office, where you can't miss them.
Vouchers redeemable at all Mama John's in Dossoles.
Recycling Stickers during event
Mama John's Voucher

Mama John's of Columbia has been offering industrial assembly-line products for all trades, all walks and all rhythms of life in a capacity Bolívar's native industry can't compare to, to the extent that all these vouchers, originally simply issued to promote sales, have become more and more truly valuable. At times, they even serve as the currency for dealings between local small-time gangs.
Irreal images disclosed by id, cognized by ego, constructed by superego.

Others will regard these as scrawls of unclear significance; Kal'tsit speculates on the Doctor's psychological state with these; in the Doctor's eyes, these fragments have come to piece together a present self.
A small medal made from metal. Gain certain amounts and receive corresponding competition rewards.
Competition Medals

Points gained for taking down OpFor troops, awarded to competitors in the form of medals. Owing to it being forged by Minos smiths, in each medal's engraving is the proverb 'all heroes arise from normal people.'
A customs certificate stamped with proof of border crossings from all over. Can be used to exchange for supplies at the Trading Station. Don't ask what purpose they have for taking these.
Clearance Permit

Used to prove the holder's legitimate entry credentials, as well as grant temporary right to remain. Absolutely essential when entering or exiting large nomadic cities. Some places don't check too thoroughly, but it's still best to have your papers on you.
Records already ravaged beyond playability. Can be exchanged with the long-time residents of the ruins for goods.
Corrupted Iberian Record
The urge to accept it comes from a craving that knows no name.
Specimen sketches scattered all over the ground in a great gale. If you help tidy them up, you can earn some supplies.
Scattered Sketches

Mineral, flora, fauna, cities; vestiges of life, and even symbols of civilization. In the meanders of this time overflowing with Originium, countless things fade from Terra's boundless history of organic evolution. Disasters unfold unabatingly, and even the grandest cities all disappear in the end. But there will always be people to record it all. She will come in her slow walk with time.
Rationing certificates issued by Rhodes Island to field operators, including vouchers. Can be used to exchange for supplies in Rhodes Island's landship, regional branches, and various safehouses.
Rhodes Island Resource Allocation Certificate

The certificate bears the signature of the administrator, an anti-counterfeiting watermark, and a detailed record of the supplies needed by the operators and for what reasons they are needed. After these three items have been verified, the responsible personnel will collect the voucher attached to the certificate and distribute the supplies to the field operator.
Dusk's handmade inkstick. Nobody knows how they're made. Perhaps you can make use of them to ask her about a few things.
Dusk Inkstick

On its front, 'starshrouded snow' is engraved in characters from ancient times. Just the talent to create these inksticks can be called rare. Dusk very rarely uses normal inksticks. If she's out of options, employing one to depict one and retrieving one fresh isn't impossible either.

Postcards printed with unique landscapes from every part, allowing a taste of all their sceneries without having to set foot outside. Can be used to exchange for goods with the staff of branch offices everywhere.
Wondrous Postcard

Landscape postcards independently published by the people all over, known for their distinct and bold framing, all using photos chosen from personal submissions, with some small fame among a subset of collectors. Different stories take root in different lands, and the scenery is always there to tell without a word.
A currency universally recognized amongst the prisoners. Can be used through secret channels to obtain what you want.
Factory Steel
You can make them during factory work hours, but it's no easy thing to sneak them off. They work as weapons as well as currency, and act as one measure of status in the prison.
A new securitized holding launched by the Mieszko Group that allows you to buy souvenirs at a Kazimierz duty free shop.
Mieszko Sports Securities

A couple blond Fortes are selling gold pieces of paper at three times the stated price. This voucher can be used to buy aid packages for competition knights in the arena, or as a bankroll to bet on, but be prepared to pay more than the number printed on it. A piece of paper, a huge sum, a knight's life of honor and shame.
An old, broken piece of a clock that can be exchanged for supplies at the weekend yard sale. Someone will want it.
Discarded Clock Dial

A once treasured clock, now reduced to nothing more than a broken dial with some small value only to collectors. You find things like this in abandoned houses. A clock silently keeping the time can be priceless, or worthless. The hour hand on the dial is stuck in place, vainly trying to turn.
A traditional Minosian food made from starch and fructose. Used to obtain rewards from the Honey Biscuit Castle.
Integrated Strategies
Delicious Honey Biscuit
Ceobe's favorite food. She is willing to part with anything in exchange for these.
These psychadelic-looking mushrooms exuding brilliant colors can enhance the performance of the Limbic System.
Magnificent Mushroom
Allows you to blur the boundary between fact and fiction, seeing things that you could not see before. Of course, this is the culprit behind your adventures.
Widely-used mechanical parts in Zumama's tribe, can be exchanged for various supplies.
Mechanical Parts

Originally seen only in Zumama's tribe, these eventually scattered throughout various places in the rainforests and wilds. Each one seems imaginative to the point of defying the laws of physics, but falls short of the industrial standards of any country.
A warrant issued by Wolumonde's Gendarmerie, authorizing entry into occupied zones to hunt down ruffians who fled amidst the chaos.
Wolumonde Search Warrant

Grip this document within your hands as if the distinctive laws of Leithanien never wavered. But, this illusion has long been shattered by the tragedy unfolding before your eyes in Wolumonde - delve deep into the mines, woods, and unclaimed vales, and bring justice to the perpetrators.
An antique currency that is still in circulation in Wolumonde; Can be used to exchange for rewards at the August Fair.
Aristocrat's Antique Aureus

The original owners of these antique coin have long departed from this remote land. However, the descendants of these decorated nobles still demanded Wolumonde's respect, and thus they passed into law the ability to circulate these coins for the purpose of satisfying their vanity.
Sold exclusively at Peterheim Middle School and all the rage among students, can be exchanged for various supplies.
Best-selling Peterheim Cookies

Snack bags usually are not a very effective way to preserve the integrity of their contents, so it's hard to find one with a complete cookie inside.
Though a bit fragmented, the overall appearance is cute enough, and the flavor is still uncompromised.
These guerilla badges from the heart of Chernobog can be given to specific individuals in exchange for some rewards.
Guerilla Squad Member Badge
'Please return this to my motherland'
These ID tags are generally intact, with only part of the text worn out. The Scar Market looks favorably upon this good fortune.
Anonymous Tags

The major problem facing Kazdel's metalworking industries is that because metallic resources are mostly used for killing soldiers instead of remembering them, the rate of soldier deaths almost outpaces the ability to produce identification tags for them. This tragic scarcity has created a ripe market for perverse collectors.
A food voucher issued by the Rhodes Island Logistics Department, redeemable at the cafeteria for a limited time for a variety of special meals.
Canteen Soup Ticket

The Rhodes Island Logistics Departmen issued this meal voucher during an event as an incentive to complete a series of missions. During the trial period, it will be distributed according to the number of missions completed or to operation results.
The paraphernalia collected during the New Year can be exchanged for great rewards.
Lantern Festival Treasure
A currency that is only good in the here-and-now. The wonderful thing about tradition is that some things that appear lost to time will suddenly wake up at the most unexpected of days.
The wonderful paraphernalia collected during the festival can be exchanged for great rewards.
Quantum Firecracker
A traditional explosive device that derives its meaning from its purpose. If an explosive goes off in a forest and no one is around to hear it, did an explosive really go off at all?
A symbol of cooperation. Can be used to unlock additional content in Contingency Contract.

Rewards earned after completing a contract. Can be used to redeem supplies.

Collecting medals issued by Emperor himself? Probably a good idea.
